title: Nutty Quick American Fennel Grill
description: A quick-fix American dish featuring fennel and lamination-puff, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan charcoal grill to medium-high heat.
Slice the fennel into 1-inch pieces and set aside.
Roll out the lamination-puff pastry to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Place the pastry on the grill and cook for 2 minutes, or until it starts to puff up.
Top the pastry with the sliced fennel, non-dairy milk, nutritional yeast, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Fold the pastry in half to enclose the filling and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Serve the nutty quick American fennel grill hot and enjoy!
Note: Binchotan charcoal grills can get very hot, so be careful not to burn yourself while cooking.
